name: 12 (2026-11-24: waiting card runs into the shared queue)
what: short sessions of tracks A, B, C, D, F and core that hand their cancelled card runs to the shared queue
note: Releases core-v0.4 to v0.6 are on main. Rulings: coord/DECISIONS/0030 to 0033. The usage window of this account is small (decision 0032 item 1): do only what the task names.

items.extra: Extra for this session: a short one (about twenty minutes) with ONE aim: hand this owner's waiting card runs to the shared queue (coord/DECISIONS/0033; harness/RULES.md section 'Shared card queue'; the orchestrator's two messages of 2026-11-24 in your inbox). No analysis, no review, no stage package, no helpers. (1) git merge --no-edit main. (2) On 2026-11-24 12:00 PST the orchestrator stopped this owner's sequencer and cancelled its pending and held jobs under the user's cap of five queued jobs. Find them (your sequencer's queue and state files; sacct -u $USER -S 2026-11-24T11:30 -X -o JobID,JobName%30,State,Start,End for state CANCELLED; harness/bin/nrpic-run status) and close each cancelled run in the run tool as stopped (harness/bin/nrpic-run finish <run id> --status stopped), unless it is to be continued in place. (3) Add every run that should still run to the shared queue: harness/bin/nrpic-queue add --label <label> [--after <label>] [--priority 2 if a gate package waits for it, else 5] -- <the same arguments you gave nrpic-run submit>; a chain that had already computed is continued from its newest restart file through --cmd with a wrapper of your package that submits at most one job (write it if it does not exist; test it with a dry run, not a submission); keep the order your plan needs with --after. The predictions written before the runs stand. Start no sequencer, submit nothing by another route, delete nothing. Keep the worktree committed, or your entries wait. (4) harness/bin/nrpic-queue list: copy the queue ids into HANDOFF.md beside what reads each run; one line in STATUS.md on the card plan; commit; push. Return the list of queue ids you added.
